root.observation_method: Conservative wall interval covering design, coordination, harness implementation, local integration, manifest and evidence preparation. No tool wait deducted; upper bound on active effort.
root.allocation: Split once equally across six canonical properties R3 through R8; split the R3 share equally between its two lengths. Author times are separate agents, not duplicate root work.

net_initial_source_reading.observation: Conservative task-start to first author timestamp, charged once in addition to the recorded later author interval.

shared_work: Foundation and shared local contracts charged once to R3-N4, used by all cases. Control helpers charged once across R4/R5/R6 and also used by R3/R7/R8. R8 proof-extension phase is a subset of its case allocation, not additional effort.
separate_work: Earlier source discovery, prior R1/R2 adapters and pinned dependency setup are prior records. Independent evidence review and deterministic admission/measurement/reporting are not target proof adaptation. Any later source repair gets another retained interval.
unavailability: Per-agent token/cost counters are not exposed.
